Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence and build consensus with senior executives, peers, and engineers across technology organizations.
Establish and govern technology delivery standards, ensuring all teams maintain current documentation, follow approved procedures, and operate within Citi's policy and control frameworks.
Partner with senior business and technology stakeholders across multiple lines of business to align engineering priorities with strategic objectives, presenting regular program reviews and progress updates to executive leadership.
Oversee change management processes for new and revised systems, ensuring appropriate controls, documentation, and approvals are in place for all implementations, including regulatory reporting changes.
Manage disaster recovery planning across the portfolio, overseeing testing cycles and approving permit-to-operate status for new applications entering production.
Assess technology and delivery risk across the organization, escalating issues with transparency and implementing corrective measures that protect the firm's operational integrity and client commitments.

Required Qualifications & Skills

15 or more years of experience in technology delivery or applications development within a large-scale, complex organization.
8 to 10 or more years of direct people management experience, including leading senior engineering managers and managing multi-team organizations through performance cycles, hiring, and organizational development.
Demonstrated ability to manage large engineering teams and multi-investment technology portfolios with accountability for quality, budget, and strategic outcomes.
Experience delivering technology solutions within the financial services industry, with working knowledge of financial products and the competitive landscape.
Advanced understanding of technology strategy and the ability to align engineering direction with business objectives at a senior organizational level.

Joining Citi at this level means taking ownership of technology that directly shapes the experience of Citi's customers and the performance of its most critical business lines. Strategic influence over a large-scale engineering organization and a broad portfolio of high-value technology investments that underpin Citi's customer-facing platforms.

Access to Citi's global learning and development resources, supporting continued professional growth at the most senior levels of the organization.
Competitive financial wellbeing package and benefits aligned to the seniority and scope of this role.
A performance-driven environment within a global institution where engineering leadership is recognized as central to business success.

Apply today to take senior ownership of Citi's Customer Management engineering organization and lead the technology transformation that will define the next generation of customer experience across a global financial institution.

DIRECTOR, DIGITAL ENGINEERING

Thresh Consulting — Strategy in Action for the AI Era

Salary: $250,000–$295,000 + up to 30% performance-based bonus and equity potential
Location: Hybrid with client travel (NYC, Chicago or Denver preferred)

ABOUT THRESH

Thresh Consulting is a modern digital consulting firm built for the AI era—where strategy, execution, and craft come together to deliver real outcomes with speed. Our specialty is helping organizations design, build, and scale digital products that create exceptional customer experiences and drive measurable value.

ROLE OVERVIEW

This role will lead Thresh's rapidly growing Digital Engineering practice, owning delivery quality across every engagement, driving talent strategy and technical hiring, and pushing innovation across AI-enabled digital engineering that keeps Thresh ahead of the market.

You will define how the Digital Engineering practice embraces agentic AI, from single-agent loops to multi-agent orchestration graphs, to radically compress the distance between spec and shipped code, raising the bar on both engineering quality and the speed from concept to production.

You'll work closely with clients, leading technical strategy and full-stack delivery teams as the hands-on engineering leader for Thresh. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and others to scaffold applications and prototype complex features in real time, showing the team and clients what modern engineering velocity looks like.

This is a leadership-team seat, not simply an engineering lead role. We are looking for a rare combination: a deeply technical engineer and a polished, credible communicator. Someone equally comfortable diving into a complex architecture challenge and standing in front of a client CTO. You will own outcomes, and share in the upside that comes with them.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

PRACTICE LEADERSHIP & GROWTH

Develop new engineering offerings and points of view (e.g., AI-native delivery cycles, spec-driven development) that differentiate Thresh in the market.
Partner with the founders on demand planning, staffing, and the practice's contribution to firm growth.
Set the technical culture and quality bar for the practice, and represent Digital Engineering in firm-level decisions.
Sit on the firm's leadership team, contributing to firm strategy beyond engineering and carrying accountability for the practice as a business line, not just a delivery function.

AI-NATIVE DEVELOPMENT & PROTOTYPING

Build functional prototypes and MVPs in hours, not weeks, using tools like Cursor and Claude Code — whether live in client discovery sessions to unblock decision-making, or internally to validate concepts and show the team what modern engineering velocity looks like.
Establish spec-driven development as the default: typed contracts, version-controlled alongside code, written so an agent can implement against them and an experienced engineer can verify correctness against the spec rather than the diff.
Stand up evaluation harnesses and quality gates for AI-generated code so velocity never outruns correctness — tests, evals, and review patterns that make speed safe.
Design agentic workflows and orchestration, including MCP-based tool and context integration, so AI tooling compounds across the team rather than forking it.
Make build-vs-buy-vs-agent architecture calls and define Thresh's AI-assisted development stack, so every engineer spends time on business logic and innovation rather than boilerplate and repetitive patterns.

TECHNICAL STRATEGY & ARCHITECTURE

Define the technical north star for client engagements, balancing speed, quality, scale, security, and maintainability in every framework and architecture decision.
Architect enterprise-grade, full-stack applications — our default greenfield stack is Next.js + TypeScript on the front-end and Node, Go, or Python on the server, with the AI workflow layer built around the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs — while remaining pragmatic and working in the client's existing stack for brownfield work, and staying ahead of the curve on emerging frameworks and AI-assisted development practices.
Own reliability, accessibility, and compliance from day one — Core Web Vitals, error budgets, accessibility baselines, and incident readiness — and engineer to the security posture each engagement requires (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI), working directly with the client's security team.
Bridge the gap between Design and Engineering by leveraging AI to translate Figma designs into production-ready component code via token-driven, system-aware pipelines.

ENGINEERING LEADERSHIP

Lead, develop, and grow the Digital Engineering team — earning trust with engineers and raising the bar.
Coach your team on the fast-evolving AI-native delivery toolchain — coding agents, evals, orchestration, and whatever comes next — ensuring the team compounds velocity, quality, and creative problem-solving as the landscape shifts.
Conduct code reviews focused on architecture, logic, and patterns — not syntax checks that AI can handle.
Create a culture of continuous learning where engineers are always exploring new tools, techniques, and ways to deliver value faster.
Balance team capacity across multiple client engagements, ensuring quality and sustainability even when demand is high.

CLIENT ENGAGEMENT & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

Serve as Thresh's senior technical voice with client engineering leadership, setting the tone for exceptional delivery standards.
Own the technical relationship with C-suite and senior client stakeholders, presenting strategy and roadmaps as a trusted advisor.
Drive scoping, estimation, and proposal development for new engagements, shaping deal structure and technical approach before a contract is signed.
Design and lead clean handoffs to in-house client teams, ensuring Thresh's technical credibility outlasts any single engagement.

WHAT YOU BRING

10-15+ years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise across the modern full-stack, including architecting complex, scalable systems and delivering production-ready software under tight timelines.
Expertise in AI coding assistants: you should be a power user of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools
, capable of demonstrating how these tools transform the development lifecycle, including spec-driven development, evals for AI-generated code, and agent orchestration in production.
5-8+ years of engineering management experience, comfortable balancing strategic leadership with tactical execution: zooming out to set direction, then zooming in to unblock an engineer.
Polished, credible communicator, equally comfortable diving into a complex architecture problem with engineers and presenting strategy to a client CTO or executive audience.
Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward experimentation, always exploring what's possible with new tools and techniques, not limited to AI.
Practice-building or offering-development experience with a business development mindset: you've developed a team or capability as a business, not just delivered projects within one.
Consulting or client-facing delivery experience is strongly preferred, with a track record of owning commercial outcomes on the engagements you lead, protecting margin and growing account value, not just delivering to spec.

WHY THRESH

Competitive compensation and performance bonus eligibility.
Healthcare benefits and 401(k) with company match.
Opportunity to work on modern, high-impact products utilizing cutting-edge AI-assisted development tools.
A culture built on clarity, craft, and teamwork, with a commitment to human competency amplified by AI tools.
Lean, partner-led teams that ship fast: your work reaches production, not slideware
A seat at the leadership table and a compensation structure built to reward high performers.

Come Near is a lean, fully distributed nonprofit behind the He Gets Us campaign, supporting a platform that reaches hundreds of millions of people across major media moments. We’re hiring a Senior Manager of Engineering to drive delivery of our highest-priority initiative: a personalized digital engagement platform.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Own delivery of engineering roadmap priorities by translating strategy into actionable plans, milestones, and sprint objectives, ensuring consistent execution and delivery.

Lead cross-functional planning with product, engineering, data and analytics, R&D, and business stakeholders, translating priorities into scoped and sequenced engineering work.

Manage priorities and tradeoffs across internal and vendor workstreams, adjusting scope and sequencing to align commitments with team capacity.

Establish and continuously improve team operating rhythms and delivery processes tailored to a distributed, fast-paced environment.

Maintain clear visibility into delivery status, dependencies, and risks; proactively communicate updates and recommendations to the VP of Engineering and Analytics.

Lead team capacity, resource, and headcount planning in partnership with the VP of Engineering and Analytics.

Establish and enforce documentation standards for requirements, acceptance criteria, and operational processes, so the team's work stays traceable and usable by others, including vendors and new hires

COMPETENCIES

Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, feedback, accountability, and talent development.

Demonstrated professional maturity, sound judgment, and composure in high-pressure or ambiguous situations.

Strong prioritization and decision-making skills, including the ability to make tradeoffs with incomplete information.

Proven ability to build scalable processes and operating models in fast-moving environments.

Skilled at driving accountability across both direct reports and external partners.

Disciplined in tracking execution and proactively surfacing risks, blockers, dependencies, and tradeoffs.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across organizational levels.

Strong documentation skills, including requirements definition, acceptance criteria, project planning artifacts, and operational documentation.

Able to translate technical complexity into clear business implications and actionable decisions.

Takes ownership of difficult or ambiguous problems directly, favoring practical action over extended deliberation.

Demonstrates a constructive, solutions-oriented mindset under pressure, consistently seeking realistic paths forward while remaining transparent about risks and constraints.

Proficient with Linear or similar project management tools for sprint planning, issue tracking, and roadmap visibility.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field required

Experience leading teams in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where processes and operating models had to be built or significantly evolved

Experience managing blended teams of employees and external engineering vendors or partners.

Sufficient technical depth to assess architectural tradeoffs, delivery risks, and engineering execution in partnership with senior technical leaders

Strong working knowledge of modern web platform architecture, API design, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) - enough to review a technical plan critically and ask the right questions, not to build it yourself

jobs.description:
Allego is a rapidly growing SaaS technology company in the Boston area and creator of the market-leading Revenue Enablement Platform. Our technology helps Go-To-Market teams build the skills and access the knowledge they need to succeed in every selling situation.

Allego is the only revenue enablement platform to be named a Leader in both the Forrester Wave™ and the inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Revenue Enablement Platforms.

Not only are we growing quickly, but we’ve also been recognized as a top place to work by The Boston Business Journal, The Boston Globe, and Inc. Magazine. In addition, Selling Power named Allego one of the 50 Best Companies to Sell For in both 2025 and 2026.

What You'll Do At Allego

We're building a modern, scalable go-to-market engine, and this role will be instrumental in shaping how we generate pipeline, accelerate revenue, and operate at scale.

As our Marketing Engineering & Operations leader, you will own the systems, processes, data, and automation that power our revenue engine. You will partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, SDR, and Sales teams to ensure our GTM motion is efficient, measurable, and built for growth.

This is not a traditional marketing operations role focused solely on campaign execution or platform administration. We're looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, operational excellence, systems expertise, and AI-driven innovation to create a world-class revenue engine.

You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building scalable processes from the ground up, and are energized by using technology and automation to solve complex business challenges.

Core Responsibilities

GTM Systems & Infrastructure

Own HubSpot as the primary marketing platform, including architecture, workflows, integrations, lifecycle management, and data governance.
Partner closely with RevOps and Salesforce teams to ensure seamless data flow and alignment across the revenue funnel.
Establish scalable standards for campaign setup, data structure, naming conventions, lifecycle stages, and operational governance.
Drive ongoing optimization of the GTM technology stack to improve efficiency, visibility, and performance.
Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and accessibility of marketing and funnel data.

Demand Generation Operations

Own the operational framework supporting demand generation programs from lead capture through qualification, routing, nurture, and handoff.
Optimize forms, landing pages, conversion paths, enrichment processes, and routing logic to maximize conversion and data quality.
Build and scale email and nurture infrastructure that supports personalized, journey-based engagement.
Develop repeatable QA processes, documentation, and governance standards that enable flawless campaign execution.
Establish clear intake, prioritization, and project management processes for marketing operations initiatives.

Lead Management & Funnel Optimization

Design and evolve a sophisticated lead management framework that combines:
ICP fit and account qualification
Firmographic and technographic data
Behavioral engagement signals
Third-party intent data

Own lead routing, assignment logic, and SLA management across the funnel.
Continuously refine scoring and qualification models based on conversion, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
Identify bottlenecks, friction points, and revenue leakage opportunities and implement solutions to improve funnel performance.
Partner with SDR and Sales leaders to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline creation.

SDR & Inbound Revenue Operations

Own the operational infrastructure supporting inbound lead management and SDR workflows.
Create feedback loops between Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams to continuously improve lead quality and conversion performance.
Monitor and optimize key metrics including speed-to-lead, contact rates, qualification rates, and pipeline generation.
Leverage automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, responsiveness, and revenue outcomes.
Ensure alignment across teams through shared processes, reporting, and accountability.

Reporting, Attribution & Revenue Insights

Partner with RevOps to develop and evolve attribution models that accurately measure marketing impact.
Build and maintain dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline creation, funnel health, campaign performance, and revenue contribution.
Monitor lifecycle conversion rates and proactively identify trends, risks, and optimization opportunities.
Deliver actionable insights that help leadership make informed investment and growth decisions.
Establish a culture of data-driven decision making across the GTM organization.

Process Excellence & Cross-Functional Leadership

Define and maintain operational frameworks, governance standards, SLAs, and prioritization processes.
Lead regular reviews of funnel performance, operational effectiveness, and strategic initiatives.
Serve as a trusted partner to Marketing, Sales, SDR, and RevOps leaders.
Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable processes, systems, and solutions.
Drive alignment across teams to ensure a consistent and efficient customer journey.

AI & Automation Strategy

Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
Implement AI-driven workflows that enhance data quality, campaign execution, lead management, reporting, and team productivity.
Evaluate emerging technologies and scale successful use cases across the GTM organization.
Introduce intelligent automation and prompt-driven workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate execution.
Develop and maintain a strategic roadmap for AI adoption within GTM Operations.

Experience You'll Bring To Allego

10+ years in marketing operations, with a track record that spans multiple stages of company growth. Has owned the full ops function — not just administered tools — at a B2B SaaS company. Has built or inherited a broken stack and made it work. Understands what $50M ARR looks like operationally and what $100M needs to look like.

Skills & Qualifications

Deep HubSpot expertise as primary admin — architecture, workflows, lifecycle management, and integration design
Strong Salesforce fluency — can work directly with RevOps or serve as a de facto admin; understands the Marketing↔CRM data layer
Has built multi-touch attribution models and MQL scoring frameworks from scratch, and iterated on them using real conversion data; experience incorporating ICP fit and intent signals (G2, Bombora, 6sense, or equivalent) into lead scoring models
Experienced with AI-powered sales engagement platforms — Nooks AI or comparable inbound SDR tools; understands how inbound lead routing logic works and how to build the feedback loop between Marketing and SDR
Comfortable with BI and reporting tools — can build executive-facing dashboards, not just pull data
Genuine curiosity and working knowledge of AI tools and automation — actively explores how AI can accelerate ops workflows, reduce manual work, and improve data quality; not waiting to be told what to adopt
Visionary orientation — can see where the function needs to be in 18 months and reverse-engineer the roadmap to get there
Has navigated cross-functional ownership disputes between Marketing, RevOps, and Sales Ops; knows how to establish and hold a RACI

Compensation & Benefits

$135,000 - $160,000 base + 10% variable bonus target + equity

jobs.title: Associate VP, CenterWell Primary Care Technology
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Associate VP, Technology Solution Implementation delivers new technological solutions to meet business needs within a specified scope while aligned to enterprise objectives. The Associate VP, Technology Solution Implementation requires a in-depth understanding of how organization capabilities interrelate across segments and/or enterprise-wide.

The Associate VP, CenterWell Primary Care Technology leads engineering across a key segment of CenterWell Primary Care’s product offerings. The individual in this role is responsible for driving a team with full autonomy to deliver solutions supportive of the organizations “big rocks”. This individual influences system design to optimize support and ensures solutions meet the business objectives and requirements. The AVP, CenterWell Primary Care Technology’s team completes and coordinates implementation of design and requirements, testing, operational readiness, and transition to the appropriate production support team. The individual in this role will have strong working knowledge of contemporary cloud and data tools, concepts, and patterns, while also being a savvy partner to our business product and strategy leaders and can co-lead technology-rich business objectives. The ideal candidate will have experience delivering both greenfield capabilities and SaaS enhancements, while also having a strong delivery and program management background. Finally, the individual in this role will bring to the organization a wealth of relevant healthcare technology experience.

Responsibilities Include

Transform Provider Productivity Through AI at Scale. Lead the design and deployment of AI-driven capabilities including ambient documentation, chart summarization, pre-visit planning, coding assistance, inbox automation, prescription workflows, and intelligent clinical decision support. Measure success through reductions in provider administrative time, improved clinician satisfaction, and increased patient-facing capacity.
Own the Technology Portfolio Supporting Practice Operations. Direct the technology roadmap for front-office, back-office, and clinic operations, including patient access, scheduling, referrals, care team workflows, intake processes, operational command centers, workflow automation, and practice performance tools. Balance operational reliability with delivery of new capabilities that improve clinic efficiency and patient experience across multi-state markets.
Drive Executive-Level Business Outcomes Through Data and Operational Intelligence.

Partner with operational and clinical leaders to translate complex business challenges into technology solutions. Lead the development of operational data assets, automation capabilities, AI-enabled insights, and decision-support platforms that improve quality performance, risk adjustment, cost of care management, productivity, and growth objectives.

Lead Large-Scale Strategic Initiatives Across the Primary Care Enterprise. Serve as the technology executive responsible for major transformation programs including EMR optimization, AI adoption, workflow modernization, acquisitions and clinic integrations, operational resilience initiatives, and growth enablement programs. Regularly engage with senior executives to align investment priorities, manage risks, and ensure delivery of measurable business value.
Build the Future State of Intelligent Care Delivery Operations. Establish the long-term strategy for AI-enabled practice operations by identifying opportunities to automate manual work, orchestrate clinical and operational workflows, leverage agentic AI capabilities, and create reusable technology platforms that can be scaled across the Primary Care organization. Drive innovation while maintaining strong governance, operational excellence, and responsible AI practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

12+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for product development, engineering, data, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives.
5+ years leading cross-functional teams comprised of product managers, software engineers, data scientists, UX designers, architects, and clinical informaticists.
Demonstrated success delivering AI-enabled products and operational capabilities at enterprise scale.
Deep understanding of healthcare delivery workflows, particularly primary care, care management, quality improvement, value-based care, and provider operations.
Experience designing and implementing modern data platforms, interoperability solutions, and AI/ML ecosystems leveraging cloud-native architectures.
Proven ability to translate business, clinical, and operational needs into technology roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
Track record of creating exceptional user experiences for physicians, advanced practice providers, clinical staff, patients, and operational associates.
Strong understanding of human-centered design principles, user research methodologies, journey mapping, and digital product development.
Experience leading enterprise AI strategy, including generative AI, predictive analytics, intelligent workflow automation, decision support, and responsible AI governance.
Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards including FHIR, HL7, APIs, and healthcare data exchange ecosystems.
Experience working with clinical, claims, operational, and consumer-generated health data.
Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing technology organizations through organizational growth, operating model transformation, and talent development.
Ability to effectively influence executive leaders, physicians, business stakeholders, and external partners without direct authority.
Strong financial management experience, including investment planning, vendor management, contract negotiations, business case development, and benefits realization.
Experience establishing product operating models, agile delivery practices, and outcome-based performance management.
Exceptional communication and leadership presence with experience presenting to senior executives, CIOs, CMIOs, clinical leaders, and boards.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.

$172,200 - $236,900 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description Of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. jobs.title: VP, Technology Operations
jobs.description:
Expion Health is building the future of pharmacy economics.
As architects of prescription economics, we design how pharmacy value is created, aligning cost, clinical decisions, and performance into one accountable system that moves beyond rebates. We help organizations stay ahead of pharmacy market change with clear insight, bold thinking, and strategies built for what's next, leading the next era of prescription economics.

The Role

The VP of Technology Operations will serve as a strategic partner to the CIO/CTO, helping translate Expion Health's business priorities into scalable technology, product, data, and operational solutions. This role is intended to strengthen enterprise technology leadership by owning business solution architecture, platform roadmaps, product delivery alignment, and cross-functional execution, while partnering closely with existing infrastructure, support, and security leadership.

This is a rare kind of technology role. You will not sit above the work handing down blueprints, and you will not be buried in a single workstream. You will carry both: the judgment to shape where Expion's technology goes, grounded in real healthcare payer market knowledge, and the discipline to get a cross functional team across business solutions, delivery, and platform functions aligned and moving.

You will lead a team of employees and contractors, own a significant technology budget, and collaborate directly with our Chief Transformation Officer. If you have spent your career building technology in healthcare, understand what clients actually need, and want the authority to modernize the platform that meets that need, this role was built for you.

What You'll Own

Technology Leadership:
Collaborate with business unit leaders and provide leadership and support by developing data-driven strategies and recommendations that help them meet our strategic goals and objectives
Build technology strategy, product roadmaps and technology blueprints in collaboration with business unit leaders and operational leaders
Provide strategic and analytical support to senior leadership when evaluating and updating organizational goals and objectives
Create actionable insights and understandings through the analysis of both quantitative and qualitative data, building recommendations that directly address organizational goal and objectives
Work directly with senior leadership to identify, analyze and address key business opportunities and critical business challenges

Product Delivery:
Provide leadership and strategic guidance during the development, commercialization, implementation, and scaling of new products and platform capabilities.
Manage product delivery, engineering, operations, and client-facing teams to ensure roadmap priorities are clearly defined, delivery dependencies are managed, and the organization is prepared for successful rollout, ongoing service delivery, and growth.
Ensure implementations are delivered on time, aligned to approved roadmap priorities, operationally supportable, and measured against adoption, client satisfaction, scalability, quality, and business value outcomes.
Ensure ongoing operations are executed on-time as per expectations

Team Development:
Responsible for resource and budget forecasting to accomplish deliverables.
Collaborate with technical architects and engineering teams to develop the scalable solutions
Provide leadership, strategic direction, and management for delivering solutions

Collaboration:
Collaborate with functional and cross-organizational leaders to ensure that all Product, Sales and Client initiatives are successfully delivered
Collaborate with business leaders to ensure strategic roadmaps meet the business ongoing and future needs
Ensure that business goals are supported in a cost effective, timely manner, with a resulting high level of client satisfaction.
Work closely with sales and marketing teams to accurately represent capabilities of products
Support Sales in business development efforts as required

Take on other work as needed to support the broader goals of the department and the company.

Scope & Mandate

Role

This role owns a significant technology budget and a team spanning business solutions, delivery, and platform functions, combining direct employees and contract resources. Priority mandates for the first 12 to 18 months include:

Increase operational efficiency with automation and agentic AI solutions
Significantly compress implementation timelines, moving toward a leaner, faster delivery model
Ensure reliability and quality of technical Operations

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, healthcare administration, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus, but real experience matters more.
10 or more years of progressive experience in technology and business architecture, with a genuine command of the healthcare payer industry, medical claims cost management, and payer business process design.
Demonstrated knowledge of developing technology strategy to advance business models in medical claims cost management solutions
Demonstrated knowledge on leveraging technology tools to enable business operations or deliver new products
Demonstrated ability to scale technology operations
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business leaders to develop solutions
Demonstrated ability to adapt to changes in business and keep up with the industry
Demonstrated ability to execute on strategic vision on time and on budget
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders
Be comfortable with being part of a collaborative, nimble, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, startup-like environment
Enjoy pushing your skills and development to manage ambiguity, be adaptable, and cultivate innovation
Be comfortable getting into details and being part of execution as much as discussing and developing strategy

Bonus Points For

Experience building technology in pharmacy benefit management, health plan, or payer environments.
A track record guiding architects and engineers to scalable solutions that support analytics, automation, and AI enabled workflows, without owning technical delivery yourself.
Strategic thinking sharp enough to hold a long-term vision while still driving what needs to happen this quarter.
A knack for building real cross functional relationships and getting a growing organization to move in the same direction.
Genuine comfort navigating ambiguity and solving problems in an environment that is still being built.

Why Expion, Why Now

Expion Health is not asking whether pharmacy economics needs to change. We have decided, and we are building. This role carries real authority: you own a significant technology budget and the calls on how ExpionIQ gets built, and the platform you shape will be used by the health plans, employers, and PBMs who trust us with their pharmacy performance. You will inherit a strong foundation and a mandate to take it further, not a blank page and no support.

Own the outcome
and build boldly, improve relentlessly
are not slogans here. They are how we expect this role to operate. If you are ready to bring real healthcare technology expertise and real ownership to a growing organization, we want to talk.

Benefits & Perks

100% remote – work anywhere in the US
Medical, dental & vision insurance
HSA & FSA options
Access to GLP-1 weight loss program
Short & long-term disability
Life Insurance and AD&D
401(k) with company match
Paid Time Off
Phone & internet allowance
Town halls & direct access to executive leadership
A company that is genuinely investing in AI – and in you!

jobs.description:
About Chalk

Chalk is building the data platform that powers the future of machine learning applications. We tear down complexity, latency, and scale barriers that have traditionally constrained ML capabilities. Our platform combines Rust-speed performance with elegant tools that developers love to use. Leading companies depend on Chalk for everything from stopping fraudulent credit card swipes, verifying identities, and maximizing clean energy capture. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineering is where Chalk meets its customers. Our FDEs are exceptional software engineers who integrate Chalk’s platform with the best ML and engineering teams in healthcare, finance, and consumer technology — running technical pilots that win deals, onboarding new customers, and engineering feature pipelines that power use cases like fraud prevention, cancer detection, and product recommendation.
Working directly with our founders, you'll lead this team and define its future. You'll own the strategy for how Chalk engages customers technically — from pre-sales pilots through onboarding, support, and expansion — and build the organization, processes, and playbooks that let the function scale with our growth. FDE is one of the most strategically important and fastest-growing functions at Chalk, and this role will shape what it becomes.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What you will do

Lead, develop, and retain Chalk's team of Forward Deployed Engineers across New York and San Francisco, and own an aggressive hiring plan as the team scales
Define the strategy and operating model for the FDE function: engagement models, account coverage, the pre-sales/post-sales balance, and how FDEs drive expansion within accounts
Own the systems that make the team run — support triage and rotations, escalation paths to Engineering, onboarding playbooks, and the processes for rolling out platform changes to customer environments
Partner closely with Sales and GTM leadership on technical pilots, evaluations, and the technical strategy behind our most important deals
Partner with Engineering leadership to channel customer learnings into the product roadmap and to sharpen the internal tooling FDEs rely on
Stay hands-on: dive into customer architectures, unblock hard technical problems, and set the technical bar for the team
Serve as an executive-level technical counterpart to customer leadership at our largest accounts
Define career paths and growth trajectories for FDEs, and champion the function's identity as we grow — deeply technical engineers embedded with customers, not sales engineering

What we're looking for

10+ years of engineering experience with 3+ years leading customer-facing engineering teams (forward deployed, solutions architecture, field engineering, or similar)
Strong hands-on technical skills — proficient in Python and SQL, comfortable going deep on customer architectures and data infrastructure
Experience across both pre-sales and post-sales complex enterprise motions: technical pilots and evaluations as well as onboarding, support, and account expansion
Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain exceptional engineers, including senior ICs
Previous experience at an early-stage, high-growth startup
Executive-level communicator who can bridge technical, business, and customer contexts
Experience building the processes and playbooks that let a customer-facing engineering team scale
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Bonus points

Previous experience as a forward deployed engineer or FDE leader at a high-growth startup
Experience building production ML systems, ML infrastructure, or data platforms
Experience scaling a customer-facing engineering function from single-digit to multi-team
Experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (fintech, healthcare)

Benefits

⚕️Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family
🏦 Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA)
🚌 Flex Commuter Benefits
🦮 Expert Healthcare Guidance
💵 Retirement savings
🏖️15 days of PTO and 14 company holidays each year
👶Paid parental leave
🌮 Daily lunch and dinner on Chalk
🥤Office is fully-stocked with drinks and snacks to fuel your work day.
🍽️ Staying late? Dinner is on us
🚖 Staying even later? Grab an Uber / Lyft home on Chalk
🌆Team building events & happy hours

Compensation

$300,000 – $350,000 - Offers equity + benefits

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

The Director E&E, Delivery is both a people manager and client leader. This person has a disciplined approach to managing our most important clients through project and program management whether it is a single large project or multiple projects that make up a program. The successful candidate is detail-oriented but can also think of the ‘big picture’ strategy to drive our client’s business forward, while building long-lasting client relationships. Has the ability to manage various types of concurrent projects from research & strategy, design, development, and deployment of web and software products. Capable of managing complex programs with multiple projects and project management resources in dynamic client environments. Has strong client-facing and strategic leadership experience along with expert program/project management skills. Has extensive experience managing direct reports with a focus on performance, career growth, and project/program management skills. They will use their expertise to coach and grow their team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Define, manage and execute various types of creative projects for clients in order to maximize client business objectives, manage client expectations, and maintain profitability.
Establish the creative operating model, communication, plan and tools to be used by the program to ensure successful delivery.
Directly manage creative project management team members, providing ongoing mentorship, career development, and performance guidance.
Ability to coach team members on best practices and act as a partner in solving client challenges.
Lead the development and implementation of standardized creative processes and tools across the Delivery team.
Oversee and deliver daily internal and client-facing status updates for engagements
Balance strategic and operational thinking with strong attention to detail and execution.

Make creative resourcing recommendations and monitor team bandwidth and effectiveness; assess program pacing and delivery health to ensure viability. Coordinate and organize tasks that support project execution and delivery. Lead discussions with key stakeholders to communicate program progress, milestones, and overall delivery health.
Manage complex creative project timelines, budgets, scope, and risks to ensure high-quality delivery outcomes. Contribute to business development efforts by helping define project scope, delivery processes, and resource estimates.
Support change management by modeling tactical approaches and managing resources across shifting project needs.
Minimal travel may be required to client sites.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of project management experience in an advertising, creative agency, production studio, or related environment
5+ years of program management experience.
7+ years experience managing an internal team and direct reports
Strong understanding of creative workflows across design, video, digital, social, and integrated campaigns
Experience with AI-enabled creative workflows or content production tools
Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills. The ideal candidate will not be hesitant to have conversations with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the success of the project or program.
Excellent problem solving, organization, time management, and risk management skills.
Experience in management and merging project artifacts into a program scale set of artifacts used to orchestrate the larger set of initiatives and optimize delivery and minimize negative risk.
The ability to be self-directed and work in a dynamic environment with resources of various skills and experience levels to ensure successful delivery.
Expertise with project management tools (Asana, Monday.com, Wrike, Jira, etc.)
Excellent scheduling and planning skills with a proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously while also actively managing project timelines
Project financial management of budget, ETC, EAC and profitability. Experience with project accounting and opportunity estimation is vital to the role.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Development - Clients & Accounts
jobs.description:
Build something people love

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

About The Team

Clients & Accounts Platform (CAP) owns the core client and account models at the heart of our product — the foundation every other team builds on top of. We build the uncompromising, simple, fully digital in-app onboarding experience Wealthsimple is known for, guiding clients from sign-up through funded accounts in minutes, not days, and almost always with no human intervention. On the backend, our platform defines and enforces the compliance and product requirements every team relies on; on the frontend, we orchestrate the onboarding modules — KYC, identity verification, agreement signing, and more — that show up across nearly every Wealthsimple product.

We're a full-stack team, and we're both platform-facing (other engineering teams are our customers) and product-facing (clients are). Our services are critical tier — when they go down, most of Wealthsimple stops working — so we hold ourselves to five nines of uptime while still shipping and iterating at tech-company speed. It's demanding work, and one of the highest-impact places to build at Wealthsimple.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager to lead Accounts Engineering, one of the teams inside CAP. Accounts Engineering builds new account types (Business Accounts, RESPs, and more), defines the core account configurations that unlock new product features, and evolves the account domain model that the rest of the company builds against. You'll manage a team of roughly 8 full-stack developers.

This team moves fast. There is always more demand than capacity — no shortage of ideas, product asks, or backlog. Your job is to turn that pressure into a high-velocity, high-quality team that ships work the company can rely on for years.

In this role you'll have the opportunity to:

Build and lead a high-velocity, high-quality full-stack engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance managing, and promoting senior ICs
Orchestrate and drive alignment on the team's architectural north star, and make sure every project ladders up to it
Partner with Product and Data Science to define the team's roadmap and resource projects — and make the hard prioritization calls when the list of things we want to do is (as always) larger than what we can actually do
Review, critique, and contribute to project technical planning — and stay close enough to the work to drive projects through to launch without surprises
Own your team's operational excellence: reliability, on-call health, SLAs, and the day-to-day quality of what we ship
Keep the team on the leading edge of AI-assisted engineering — across planning, code review, incident response, and anywhere else it can compound — and keep pushing that edge, treating "how much faster AI can make us" as a question we never stop asking

What we're looking for:

4+ years managing high-performance software development teams through multiple successful product launches, including coaching and growing senior and staff ICs
Strong full-stack technical background — system design chops are essential, and front-end depth is a real plus. You lead from the front technically: you can sit in a design review and push back with substance, and you can spot what's missing in a project plan before the team does
A "ship it" mentality: you set a high bar for pace, iteration, and quality, and you build a team culture around it — including having the hard conversations when someone isn't meeting the bar
A track record of building teams from the ground up — hiring, performance managing, and promoting
Comfort operating under real pressure: you treat "we don't have enough capacity" as a strategy problem, not a complaint, and you make strong, opinionated calls when there's more to do than time to do it
Metrics-oriented: you don't speculate, you prove. You expect the same of the engineers you lead
An AI-first mindset — you use AI as a core part of how you and your team work, not as a side experiment
A strong communicator who makes their team's work visible across the organization and manages upward and across effectively — negotiating priorities with peer managers, setting expectations with stakeholders, and making sure leadership understands the trade-offs behind the roadmap

Nice-to-have's:

Experience in the fintech or banking industry
Experience managing both platform teams (where other engineering teams are your customers) and product teams (where clients are)
Hands-on experience with Rails, Kotlin, and/or React
Deep experience across both backend and frontend development
Comfortable writing your own SQL to answer your own questions about the business

Why Wealthsimple?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple:
We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement:
We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement:
We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring:
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California

The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is seeking a Director, Mission Engineering & Management
to own program and mission execution for a new constellation-ready spacecraft bus product line. Our first mission is a 10-satellite demo launch — the plan is to scale to hundreds of spacecraft per year.

new_jobs.title: Director – GPU Stack Unified Build & Release Platform
new_jobs.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.

The Role

AMD's AI software stack is moving fast — and keeping pace means shipping complete, validated GPU stack releases to customers as quickly as the software can evolve. Today, that release velocity is limited by the coordination overhead between layers: firmware, kernel driver, and ROCm each have their own build systems, their own workflows, and no shared release baseline. Every customer delivery requires manual effort to assemble and validate a coherent recipe across all three, and lower-level components — firmware and kernel — are increasingly the bottleneck to getting the full stack out the door.

We're building the infrastructure to change that: a unified build and CI platform that treats the complete GPU stack as a single deliverable, built from source, validated together, and releasable on demand. The result is faster time-to-customer for validated, fully-supported GPU stack releases — without sacrificing the stability that product lines depend on.

The Person

We need an AMD Director to own this area end-to-end. You'll lead a tiger team of 5–10 engineers while spending roughly half your time in the code yourself — making architecture calls, driving the hardest technical problems, and setting the bar for how the team works. The other half is working directly with executives to sequence the rollout in a way that accelerates release velocity without disrupting active product lines. This is an organizational change effort as much as it is an engineering one — and we need someone who can operate credibly at both levels without giving up either.

Key Responsibilities

Technical direction for the unified build and release platform — from PoC architecture decisions through phased production rollout, you'll set the direction and be accountable for the outcome. You'll have senior ICs executing against that direction; your job is to make sure the strategy is right and stays right as the platform matures.
Executive alignment on phased rollout — the transition to a unified platform cannot delay active product shipments. You'll work directly with executives and product line owners to design a rollout sequence that delivers value incrementally, identifies and mitigates risk at each phase, and builds organizational confidence in the new platform before dependencies on the old one are removed.
Organizational change across firmware, kernel, and ROCm teams — unifying the build and release process for 1,000+ developers requires more than good tooling. You'll work with component team leads and engineering directors to align on new workflows, build the cultural shift toward shift-left development and trunk health, and get organizational buy-in at the right level.
Tiger team leadership — you'll directly lead the senior engineers building the platform, including the Build Architect and CI Infrastructure Engineer. You'll keep them unblocked, make the cross-cutting technical calls, and ensure the build and CI workstreams converge into a coherent system.
Code at ~50% — and mean it — for this role, this is a real commitment, not a line in a job description. You'll own meaningful parts of the platform yourself, not just review others' work. We're at a pivotal moment in the industry: agentic AI tools are genuinely changing what it means to be a technical leader, and the best engineering teams are being led by people who are in it alongside them. If you've drifted away from coding over the years but are ready to re-engage — especially with AI as a force multiplier getting you back up to speed — we want to talk. What matters is the commitment, not whether you've been shipping code every week.
Sharpen your agentic AI engineering leadership — this platform has a scope (65+ firmware components, 1,000+ developers, multi-layer GPU stack) that demands agentic AI as a genuine force multiplier, not a productivity experiment. You'll be setting the example for how senior technical leaders use these tools, developing that capability in your team, and building an organization that moves faster because of it.
Own a strategic area end-to-end — from PoC through production rollout, across build systems and CI, across firmware and kernel and ROCm, across the tiger team and the executive stakeholders. Full ownership, full accountability.
Direct line to customer impact — the platform you build determines how quickly AMD can put validated GPU stack releases in front of customers. That's a board-level concern and you'll be the person driving it.
Organizational change at scale — this is a rare opportunity to shift how a major hardware company builds and releases its GPU stack, with the executive support and mandate to make it stick.
Open-source aligned — this work follows the same shift-left, trunk-health principles driving AMD's ROCm open-source direction, with visibility into AMD's most strategic hardware and software programs.

Preferred Experience

Deep software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership at the director or fellow level
Deep technical range across build systems, CI/CD infrastructure, and software release pipelines — credible with senior ICs, fluent with engineering executives
Track record of driving large-scale infrastructure or platform modernization across multiple teams with competing priorities
Experience sequencing technical change in a way that protects active product commitments — you know how to be bold about direction while being careful about disruption
Executive-level communication: able to frame technical tradeoffs as business decisions, build alignment across stakeholders, and hold accountability for outcomes at an organizational level
Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing small teams in a greenfield or PoC context
Fluency with agentic AI workflows (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, etc.) — both as a personal productivity multiplier and as a capability you actively develop in your team
Experience with firmware, kernel, or embedded software release pipelines and their specific constraints
Familiarity with GitHub Actions, self-hosted CI infrastructure, and cloud-based build environments (AWS)
Experience driving adoption of shift-left development practices across large engineering organizations

new_jobs.title: Director / Fellow – Developer Productivity & Platform, ROCm
new_jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

ROCm is a 1,200-person engineering organization. The people in it are productive individually. The organization as a whole is not. Developers across firmware, kernel, build, and software teams encounter the same friction points — slow toolchains, fragmented workflows, bespoke local infrastructure assembled team-by-team to fill gaps nobody formally owns — and solve them independently, each time, in different ways. No one has owned this problem horizontally.

The problem is real, the scope is rare — a horizontal mandate across a 1,200-person engineering organization, with a clear problem and leadership support to address it. Developer experience roles at this scope don't come up often.
Build a function from scratch — you'll establish what developer productivity means at AMD, prove the model, and scale it. Budget exists to grow the team beneath you once the function is validated. This is a founding role, not a slot in an existing org chart.
Direct line to leadership — you'll report directly to the head of the Developer Organization, with the access and visibility to move quickly and escalate blockers without bureaucratic overhead.
Direct impact on AMD's open-source velocity — ROCm is AMD's bet on the AI software ecosystem. Engineering time is the constraint. This role directly attacks that constraint.
Breadth unusual for an IC — firmware, kernel, build, runtime, compiler, ML frameworks — this role touches all of it. If you want depth in one area, this isn't it. If you want horizontal breadth with genuine technical impact across a large, complex organization, it's a rare fit.

The Person

We're looking for a senior individual contributor to serve as the horizontal technical lead for developer productivity across the entire ROCm development organization. You'll sit in the Developer Organization (DevOps and QA), reporting directly to the head of that organization, but your mandate spans the full 1,200-person engineering body — surfacing the highest-friction points in the developer experience, and eliminating them: through infrastructure improvements, workflow redesign, or direct fixes to the development stack itself. The goal is measurable, durable improvement in engineering velocity across the company — not for one team, for all of them.

This is a solo IC role to start. You'll build the function and prove the model. We have budget to hire supporting engineers beneath you as the work matures, but the first job is to establish what this function owns, what it can change, and what it's worth.

Key Responsibilities

Own the developer productivity problem horizontally across ROCm — this is not a team-scoped role. You'll build a continuous, empirical view of where developers across the organization lose time: through direct interviews, instrumentation, friction logging, and analysis of build and CI data. This picture drives your roadmap.
Identify and eliminate the highest-leverage friction points — once you can see where the time goes, you prioritize ruthlessly. Some fixes are infrastructure (build caching, environment provisioning, test selection); some are workflow changes (pre-submit gates, LKG baselines, CI reproduction paths); some are direct improvements to the development stack (compiler feedback, incremental build tuning, developer-facing tooling). You'll own and drive all three categories.
Build shared tooling that replaces fragmentation — every ROCm component team has assembled workarounds for gaps nobody formally owns. Your job is to surface that work, identify what should become canonical, and drive consolidation into shared, maintained tooling — eliminating the incentive for any team to build their own infrastructure from scratch.
Partner with DevOps, QA, and component team leads — you will influence without authority across autonomous teams with their own roadmaps and priorities. Earning credibility requires deep technical fluency alongside organizational effectiveness; this role requires both.
Define and instrument the metrics that make productivity legible — build time, incremental compile time, time-to-first-green, environment setup time, onboarding completion rates. If we can't measure it, we can't improve it. You'll own the measurement framework and use it to demonstrate impact to engineering leadership.
Translate developer pain into infrastructure investments — you'll be the voice of developer experience on the DevOps roadmap. You'll bring structured evidence of friction points back to the teams who can address them, and help prioritize what gets built next.
Build and eventually lead a team — this role starts solo, but the expectation is that you'll prove the model and grow the function. Budget exists to hire supporting engineers beneath you; how you structure that team and when you pull that trigger is part of what you'll own.
Developer friction audit — a systematic, org-wide map of where the 1,200 developers in ROCm lose time today: slow builds, environment setup overhead, broken trunk, manual workarounds for missing automation. The output is a prioritized investment list, not a document that sits in a folder.
Build acceleration program — identify the highest-impact levers for reducing build latency across ROCm component repos: distributed build caching (sccache or equivalent), incremental build configuration tuning, faster CI test selection. Measure before and after; publish results.
Developer environment standardization — define and drive adoption of a reproducible, pre-configured developer environment standard (Dev Containers or equivalent) that eliminates weeks of onboarding archaeology and gives any engineer a working, fully-tooled environment within 15 minutes.
CI failure reproduction as a first-class workflow — today, reproducing a CI failure means finding a matching machine manually. You'll drive the infrastructure change that makes any CI failure interactively reproducible on equivalent hardware, eliminating one of the highest-friction moments in the development cycle.
Shadow infra consolidation — surface and evaluate the custom scripts, ad-hoc tooling, and bespoke CI configurations built by component teams to fill platform gaps; identify duplication; drive consolidation into shared, owned tooling with formal support.
Developer productivity KPIs — instrument and publish a quarterly developer productivity dashboard used by engineering leadership to set priorities and track improvement over time.

Preferred Experience

Software engineering experience with significant depth in developer tooling, platform engineering, build systems, or DevOps
Strong hands-on coding ability — this is an IC role; you will be in the code, not just driving process
Demonstrated track record of improving developer experience at scale across organizations of 100+ engineers — measurable outcomes required
Proven ability to operate horizontally across autonomous teams, building alignment and driving adoption without organizational authority
Deep understanding of CI/CD systems, build infrastructure, and developer workflow tooling — you need to understand the problem space at a technical level to earn credibility with the teams you'll work with
Strong communication skills: able to translate developer friction into engineering priorities and make a crisp case for investment to senior leadership
Experience in GPU or systems software environments (kernel, firmware, runtime, compiler) — understanding what it actually feels like to develop in this stack is a significant advantage
Familiarity with the ROCm stack or adjacent GPU compute ecosystems (HIP, CUDA, ML frameworks)
Experience with build caching, distributed build systems, or developer environment tooling at scale
Fluency with agentic AI workflows (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) — the scope of a horizontal role across a large, fragmented organization is exactly where these tools compound

About The Role

Sunday is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead and elevate a talented, close-knit engineering team through a pivotal moment. We're building something novel in the lawn care category, not reinventing an existing category, and our engineers are energized by that focus. This role exists to protect and grow that momentum: setting technical vision, building org-level capability, and bringing in an AI focus.

This is a hands-on leadership role with real strategic ownership. You'll need to be credible in the weeds, able to understand what's happening in the codebase and the business, while also sitting close to company leadership, translating company vision into an engineering roadmap, and making the structural calls the team doesn't have bandwidth to make themselves.

Above all, we need a builder. Someone who gets genuinely excited about writing code and shipping products, not solely a people manager. You'll rally the team by being in it with them, and you'll partner directly with Product as a true collaborator, not an order-taker: we need someone who understands how product and engineering decisions shape each other.

Vision & Strategy

Develop a technical vision for engineering that ties directly to Sunday's business goals, and translate it into a 6–12 month roadmap built with Product and the Leadership Team

AI-Native Product Direction

Execution & Delivery

Cross-Functional Leadership & Product Partnership

new_jobs.title: Director of Development Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Director of Development Engineering to join our team. 
Position Description

The Director of Development Engineering oversees all civil, site, and nuclear engineering activities required to advance Aurora powerhouse sites through development and into construction readiness. Your team produces the technical deliverables — site layouts, basis-of-design packages, geotechnical and environmental assessments, and engineering inputs to permitting — that underpin state/local approvals and NRC licensing (coordinated with Oklo's Environmental & Permitting team), project financing, and construction handoff. Environmental & Permitting and Project Finance are coordinated with Oklo's dedicated teams.
Specific responsibilities may include:

Lead development engineering across all active sites: site layout, civil/grading design, geotechnical investigation, hydrology, and infrastructure planning
Solutions engineering for potential co-located buildings such as advanced manufacturing and data centers
Produce basis-of-design documentation sufficient for project finance due diligence and EPC handoff
Manage third-party engineering consultants and coordinate with Oklo's internal nuclear design team
Provide engineering inputs to NRC licensing and NEPA processes coordinated by Oklo's Environmental & Permitting team
Develop and maintain engineering standards, templates, and quality protocols for the Development organization
Partner with Oklo’s New Product Integration (NPI) team to translate reactor design requirements, siting criteria, and product evolution into site-specific technical constraints and development scope — ensuring early alignment between product design and site realities
Develop and own site constraints packages for each Aurora powerhouse development site, synthesizing geotechnical, hydrological, environmental, grid, and regulatory inputs into a single authoritative technical baseline that governs site selection, design, and permitting decisions
Integrate and quality-control deliverables from civil, geotechnical, environmental, and nuclear engineering consultants — ensuring all third-party work products are consistent, current, and accurately reflected in the site constraints package and project schedule
Own the development engineering schedule and provide cross-functional technical leadership to identify, prioritize, and mitigate technical risks and fatal flaws on project sites — coordinating with Project Development, Transmission & Interconnection, and Oklo’s Environmental & Permitting team to surface issues early and preserve development optionality
Lead structured technical risk reviews at each stage gate, evaluating site constraints packages against go/no-go criteria and escalating unresolved fatal flaw risks to the VP of Development with clear options analysis and recommended disposition
Build and manage a team of engineers across civil/site/electrical and nuclear development disciplines
Provide engineering support for Isotope production facilities, including facility layout, utility infrastructure design, and integration with co-located Aurora powerhouse systems
Lead development engineering for Nuclear Lifecycle Innovation Campuses (NLICs), coordinating multi-use site design across power generation, isotope production, and research facility components

Minimum Qualifications:

12+ years in energy, infrastructure, advanced manufacturing or data center project development engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
Strong civil/site engineering background; nuclear project experience highly valued
Experience producing engineering deliverables for project financing and EPC handoff
PE license strongly preferred; experience with DOE or NRC-regulated facilities a significant advantage

Competencies

We are looking for a Director of Development Engineering that is:
Passionate about clean energy 
Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
Willing and able to learn quickly
Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
Willing to think differently and do things in new ways 
Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before 
Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
Able to communicate technical content and results verbally 

Who you are:

A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.
Motivated : You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.
A team-player : Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.
An excellent communicator : We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.
Creative : Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.
Detail-oriented : This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

Job Summary

The Director of Engineering – Design is responsible for global product design at SaniSure. Scope includes assuring velocity and efficiency of drawing and Bill of Material throughput while maintaining accuracy and quality, tracking and managing associated key performance indicators (KPIs), selecting and deploying software, training, design tools, and design libraries, authoring and updating design SOPs and Work Instructions, engineering data integrity and data services, and the Engineering portions of product change control and change management, and urgently resolving design-related issues that impact production and end-customers.

Manage the global team responsible for computer-aided design (CAD) at SaniSure. Set and continuously improve global CAD standards, templates, design libraries, and assure deployment and training.
